blocks.text: You can test forwarding policies to verify that network traffic is correctly routed through the intended interfaces in your Zero Trust Branch configuration. This helps ensure that the routing logic you defined is functioning as expected.

blocks.item: Log in to the branch appliance over SSH using the corresponding management IP address and credentials.
Choose a source device (e.g., a virtual machine) to which the policy applies and ping an IP address (e.g., 8.8.8.8).
